lines: If your car stalls in a freezing blizzard at night, do not leave the vehicle.
Mark needs to survive the freezing night on a dark highway while snow piles high.
Heavy snow falls fast around the car and blocks every single window completely now.
The freezing wind howls outside the metal walls as Mark sits trapped in the dark.
One. Stay right inside the car because it is your best shelter from death.
A car is much easier for the rescue crews to find than a single person.
Two. Clear all the snow from the exhaust pipe first before you start anything.
A blocked pipe fills the entire cabin with deadly carbon monoxide in just minutes.
Mark wipes the deep snow away from the back pipe with freezing bare hands.
Three. Run the engine for only 10 minutes each hour to keep warm inside.
Crack a window just a little bit so fresh air can flow inside safely.
Tie a bright cloth to the antenna so rescue teams spot the car easily.
Turn on the inside light at night so passing search crews can see you.
Mark finishes the safety steps and waits patiently for the morning rescue teams.
It was the correct survival plan for anyone trapped on a winter night.
There was just one unexpected problem waiting outside in the deep snowdrifts.
part1.cliffhanger: A massive snowplow approaches from behind without seeing the buried car.
